text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's weird! I've been working on using my diaphragm, but my voice isn't coming out right…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Darn it. I won't be able to cheer anyone up with such a weak voice!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well… It doesn't seem like my singing voice is improving very much. I can't seem to put any oomph into it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Argh, I can't lose spirit this easily! I'm going to try singing from my diaphragm again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to be suffering from fatigue. We may need to rethink her race schedule.
